correctness.rationale: 2x2 Cayley–Hamilton exponential interpolation and positive eigenvalue-difference scalar give an exact all-parameter two-drug sign identity; 1-state matrices commute. An explicit common-switching 3x3 conservative model changes ordering from t=1/5 to t=1; rational degree-40 series and rigorous norm remainder certify the sign.

originality.rationale: The novelty claim is the biologically constrained two-state all-duration order rigidity combined with the sharp three-state fixed-drug duration reversal. This was not implied by the inspected 2012 two-type repeated-pulse extinction work nor by the inspected 2015 drug-alternation experiment; matrix-exponential interpolation itself is classical. Partial source access leaves historical priority provisional.

value.rationale: Minimal phenotype complexity for reversal caused by varying identical drug exposure duration is a motivated structural criterion in bacterial-persistence models. A universal two-phenotype duration-independent order sign and a 3-state same-drug witness expose a concrete limitation of common two-type models beyond textbook commutator arithmetic.
